name: ORG Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: ORG Technology Co.,Ltd. stands as a prominent provider of comprehensive packaging solutions, extending its operations both within China and across international markets. Its extensive service portfolio encompasses brand strategy and planning, packaging design and manufacturing, product filling services, and sophisticated information-driven marketing support. A core area of its expertise lies in the research, design, development, production, and distribution of a diverse range of metal packaging products. Specifically, ORG Technology manufactures both two-piece and three-piece metal cans designed for a vast array of contents. This includes a wide spectrum of beverages such as beers, carbonated and functional drinks, various plant and milk-based proteins, fruit juices, teas, and Alcopops, as well as food items like condiments, formula milk, ketchup, and diverse canned fruits, seafood, and meats. Its client base spans numerous sectors, notably the food and beverage industry, medical and health, and chemical industries. Established in 1994, the company was initially known as ORG Packaging Co.,Ltd. before officially adopting its current name, ORG Technology Co.,Ltd., in April 2018. Its corporate headquarters are located in Beijing, People's Republic of China.
